description: This Java source file defines the CatalinaContainer class, which manages the setup, configuration, and lifecycle of an embedded Tomcat server within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for initializing, starting, stopping, and configuring web applications, clustering, connectors, SSL, and valves.

classes.name: CatalinaContainer
classes.description: Main class implementing the Container interface to manage an embedded Tomcat server, including initialization, startup, shutdown, and webapp deployment.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the Tomcat server with configuration, clustering, valves, connectors, and web applications.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the embedded Tomcat server and logs connector and server info.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the Tomcat server gracefully.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of this container instance.

methods.name: retrieveTomcatEngineConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the engine configuration property from the container configuration.

methods.name: prepareTomcatServer
methods.description: Sets system properties and initializes the Tomcat server instance.

methods.name: prepareTomcatEngine
methods.description: Configures the Tomcat engine with name and JVM route.

methods.name: prepareHost
methods.description: Prepares the Host object, including virtual hosts and app base.

methods.name: prepareVirtualHost
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a virtual host with aliases.

methods.name: prepareTomcatClustering
methods.description: Configures clustering for the host if specified.

methods.name: prepareChannelReceiver
methods.description: Creates and configures a NioReceiver for clustering.

methods.name: prepareChannelSender
methods.description: Creates a ReplicationTransmitter for clustering.

methods.name: prepareChannelMcastService
methods.description: Creates a McastService for clustering.

methods.name: prepareClusterManager
methods.description: Creates a ClusterManager instance based on configuration.

methods.name: prepareClusterValve
methods.description: Creates a ReplicationValve with filter settings.

methods.name: prepareTomcatEngineValves
methods.description: Configures various valves such as cross-subdomain, SSL, and access logs.

methods.name: prepareTomcatConnectors
methods.description: Creates connectors based on configuration.

methods.name: prepareConnector
methods.description: Configures a single Tomcat connector, including SSL and protocols.

methods.name: prepareSslHostConfigs
methods.description: Creates SSLHostConfig objects for connectors.

methods.name: prepareSslHostConfig
methods.description: Configures SSLHostConfig with properties and certificates.

methods.name: prepareSslHostConfigCerts
methods.description: Creates SSLHostConfigCertificate objects for SSL configuration.

methods.name: prepareSslHostConfigCert
methods.description: Configures individual SSL certificates.

methods.name: loadWebapps
methods.description: Loads and deploys web applications asynchronously.

methods.name: getWebappMounts
methods.description: Returns list of webapp mount points for a given WebappInfo.

methods.name: createCallableContext
methods.description: Creates a Callable task to initialize a web application context.

methods.name: prepareContext
methods.description: Prepares a StandardContext for a web application, including resources, filters, and parameters.

methods.name: getWebappRootLocation
methods.description: Resolves the root location of a webapp from WebappInfo.

methods.name: getWebappMountPoint
methods.description: Determines the mount point for a webapp.

methods.name: isContextDistributable
methods.description: Checks if a webapp context is distributable based on configuration and webapp info.
